commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Mario Melero blows his whistle for an infringement. Girona have a free kick.
90+4' It's like he was asking for a caution. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Girona was in an offside position.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Michel prepares a substitution. Ivan Martin is replaced by Portu (Girona).
88' Substitution. Bryan Gil leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alejandro Frances (Girona).

85' Good chance! Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
84' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

82' 2 - 1 Goal! Mika Marmol displays great vision and sends a pass to Fabio Silva (Las Palmas), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:1.
82' Diego Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) replacing Enzo Loiodice.
82' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Manuel Fuster.
81' Mario Melero shows a yellow card to Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) for a tough tackle.

79' 2 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Yaser Asprilla (Girona) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
79' The attendance is 10088.
76' The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a throw-in.
74' That's the end of the game for Viktor Tsygankov, who is replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
70' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
68' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
68' Good work from Girona as they win a corner.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kirian Rodriguez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas).
66' Substitution. Donny van de Beek makes his way off the pitch and Yaser Asprilla (Girona) comes on as his replacement.
66' Michel decides to make a substitution. Abel Ruiz will be replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
64' The ball is out of play. Girona will take a throw-in.
62' Las Palmas keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

58' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
56' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Girona.
53' Girona force a corner. They send men into the box.
52' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:4.
47' The linesman signals a throw-in for Las Palmas.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Mario Melero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Although Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is just on the bench, Mario Melero has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
45+5' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
45+4' Corner kick. Girona will have an opportunity.
45+2' A corner kick by Girona is thwarted by the well prepared Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas).

45+1' Abel Ruiz (Girona) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Jasper Cillessen to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
45+1' Abel Ruiz (Girona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Mario Melero shows a yellow card to Scott McKenna (Las Palmas), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Girona!
44' There's a break in play and referee Mario Melero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Girona using VAR. This could be interesting!
43' PENALTY APPEAL by Girona, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
42' The foul by Donny van de Beek (Girona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mario Melero.
41' Now Girona have a corner.
39' Girona have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
37' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
35' Bryan Gil (Girona) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Jasper Cillessen was alert and made an astonishing save!
34' Girona have a corner.
33' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
32' A free kick is awarded to Girona.
30' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
24' The ball goes out for a corner. Las Palmas can continue in their attacking effort.
23' Dangerous play by Miguel Gutierrez (Girona). Mario Melero blows his whistle for a foul. Las Palmas are awarded the free kick.
21' The number of offsides is – 6:3.
19' Bryan Gil (Girona) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
17' Las Palmas are seeing far more of the ball now.
15' Girona are ruled offside.
12' The ball goes behind for a corner. Las Palmas will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
8' 1 - 0 Abel Ruiz (Girona) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
5' One of the players from Las Palmas times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' The referee points to the corner flag and Las Palmas will take a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Girona will have the kick-off.
Mario Melero will officiate today.
